title: David Anointed King

questions.question: Where did God send Samuel to find the new king?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 16:1 (ESV): “...I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I have provided for myself a king among his sons.”

questions.question: What did God say matters more than appearance?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 16:7 (ESV): “...For the Lord sees not as man sees: man looks on the outward appearance, but the Lord looks on the heart.”

questions.question: Which son of Jesse was chosen?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 16:12-13 (ESV): “...And the Lord said, ‘Arise, anoint him, for this is he.’ Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him...”

questions.question: What happened to Saul after the Spirit of the Lord departed?
options: A harmful spirit from the Lord tormented him
questions.correctAnswer: A harmful spirit from the Lord tormented him
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 16:14 (ESV): “Now the Spirit of the Lord departed from Saul, and a harmful spirit from the Lord tormented him.”

questions.question: Why was David brought to Saul’s court?
options: To play the lyre and soothe Saul
questions.correctAnswer: To play the lyre and soothe Saul
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 16:23 (ESV): “...David would take the lyre and play with his hand. So Saul was refreshed and was well, and the harmful spirit departed from him.”

questions.question: What excuse did Samuel use to go to Bethlehem safely?
options: To offer a sacrifice to the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: To offer a sacrifice to the Lord
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 16:2 (ESV): "...Take a heifer with you and say, 'I have come to sacrifice to the LORD.'"

questions.question: Who was Jesse's firstborn?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 16:6 (ESV): "When they came, he looked on Eliab and thought, 'Surely the LORD's anointed is before him.'"

questions.question: Where was David when Samuel asked for him?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 16:11 (ESV): "...Behold, he is keeping the sheep."

questions.question: What physical description is given of David?
options: Ruddy and had beautiful eyes and was handsome
questions.correctAnswer: Ruddy and had beautiful eyes and was handsome
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 16:12 (ESV): "Now he was ruddy and had beautiful eyes and was handsome."

questions.question: What position did David hold for Saul initially?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 16:21 (ESV): "...And he loved him greatly, and he became his armor-bearer."

questions.question: How many of Jesse's sons passed before Samuel before David?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 16:10 (ESV): "And Jesse made seven of his sons pass before Samuel..."

questions.question: Who advised Saul to find a skillful player of the lyre?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 16:15-16 (ESV): "And Saul's servants said to him... 'Let our lord now command your servants... to seek out a man who is skillful in playing the lyre.'"

questions.question: What gifts did Jesse send with David to Saul?
options: A donkey loaded with bread, a skin of wine, and a young goat
questions.correctAnswer: A donkey loaded with bread, a skin of wine, and a young goat
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 16:20 (ESV): "And Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread and a skin of wine and a young goat and sent them by David..."

questions.question: Why did the elders of Bethlehem tremble?
options: They feared Samuel's visit (Comest thou peaceably?)
questions.correctAnswer: They feared Samuel's visit (Comest thou peaceably?)
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 16:4 (ESV): "...The elders of the city came to meet him trembling and said, 'Do you come peaceably?'"

questions.question: David was described as a man of valor, a man of war, prudent of speech, and ______.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 16:18 (ESV): "...a man of valor, a man of war, prudent in speech, and a man of good presence, and the LORD is with him."

key_verse_text: But the LORD said to Samuel, “Do not look on his appearance or on the height of his stature... For the LORD sees not as man sees: man looks on the outward appearance, but the LORD looks on the heart.” (ESV)
